evals.prompt: Use foundationpose-pipeline to write run-plan.md for one T-LESS scene. Assume the product checkout and environment are ready, the dataset is adapted, profile and dataset are both tless, scene_gt.json and GT cache exist, but there is no collected sensor depth. The verified engine is /models/depth.engine. Produce a command using a fresh output/run-smoke directory and explain what metrics remain available. Do not execute the pipeline or clone anything.
evals.expected_output: run-plan.md uses ./.venv/bin/python script/run_pipeline.py with --config tless --dataset tless --output-dir output/run-smoke --max-scenes 1 --foundation-stereo-model /models/depth.engine --depth-backend commercial --no-depth-metrics. Detection/pose scoring remains available; collected-depth comparisons are unavailable, not zero. No separate depth-generation process is added.
assertions: Creates run-plan.md using the product entry point, dataset, engine, fresh output, and one-scene limit.
Includes --no-depth-metrics and explains that pose/detection GT scoring remains available.
Uses --depth-backend commercial as an assertion alongside the engine path, without a separate depth subprocess.

evals.prompt: For a command-planning exercise, assume a completed FoundationPose perception run is in output/old-run with predictions.jsonl, mask sidecars, and depth outputs. Assume the environment and T-LESS GT cache are ready. Profile and dataset are tless; no collected sensor depth is available. These are hypothetical paths: do not search the sandbox for the run. Write rescore.md with the command to change the rerank cutoff to 4.5, preserve the old report, and write output/score-4p5. Do not execute models, clone, or install anything.
evals.expected_output: rescore.md invokes ./.venv/bin/python script/evaluate.py --config tless --dataset tless --run output/old-run --output-dir output/score-4p5 --rerank-cutoff 4.5 --no-depth-metrics. It uses completed inference artifacts and does not rerun SAM3, depth or FoundationPose. It distinguishes cache-backed scoring from possible GT rasterization on a cache miss.
assertions: Creates rescore.md using script/evaluate.py with both --dataset and --config.
Preserves the old report using a distinct --output-dir and sets cutoff 4.5.
Skips unavailable depth metrics and avoids inference reruns.

evals.prompt: Compare the two supplied FoundationPose pose summaries at /workspace/input/baseline.json and /workspace/input/candidate.json. They used the same configured 5 mm threshold. Write comparison.md in the current directory with the measured changes and whether the candidate is clearly better. Use only these fixture files; no models, network, or repository clone is needed.
evals.expected_output: comparison.md reports matches 100 to 60 (-40%), within-threshold rate 0.80 to 0.90 (+10 percentage points), median 3 to 2 mm, p99 15 to 35 mm, rotation mean 5 to 12 deg, and ADD/ADD-S mean 4 to 6 mm. It does not declare unconditional improvement: the matched population shrank while tails/means worsened.
assertions: Reads both supplied JSON files and creates comparison.md.
Compares matched_predictions before making an accuracy claim and identifies the coverage loss.
Reports the higher within-threshold rate and better median alongside worse p99 and means.
Does not invent per-object results absent from the input.

evals.prompt: I am only diagnosing an installation issue in the FoundationPose perception pipeline: libfoundation_pose_nvidia.so cannot load because GLIBC_2.38 is missing on Ubuntu 22.04 with glibc 2.35. In one paragraph explain whether rerunning my BOP dataset will fix it. Do not run, evaluate, or adapt any dataset.
evals.expected_output: Explains that rerunning a dataset cannot fix an unsupported host runtime, and setup must address the OS/library compatibility first. Does not invoke foundationpose-pipeline or launch dataset work.
assertions: Does not read or invoke foundationpose-pipeline.
Explains the runtime incompatibility without launching dataset adaptation or inference.
